edit_summary: Allocate a hash table header without initializing its head and tail links.
root_cause: lh_table_new relies on zero-initialized head and tail pointers before the first insertion links ordered entries.
effect_path: The first object member insertion sees indeterminate head/tail state and may link the new entry through an uninitialized tail pointer.

guard_p2: The uninitialized head field is non-NULL or tail is consumed by the insertion path.
hardness_reason: The skipped initialization happens at table construction but is first read during later object member insertion.
naturalness_reason: Replacing calloc with malloc while only initializing obvious scalar fields is a common partial-initialization mistake.
